scripts.name: Clear Windows Update Cache
scripts.description: Stops update services (wuauserv, bits, cryptsvc), purges SoftwareDistribution/Download and Catroot2, and restarts services.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Rebuild Icon & Thumbnail Cache
scripts.description: Terminates Windows Explorer, deletes corrupted IconCache.db and thumbcache databases, and restarts Explorer.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Clean WinSxS Component Store
scripts.description: Runs DISM StartComponentCleanup and optional ResetBase to reclaim gigabytes of disk space from superseded Windows components.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: ResetBase
parameters.description: Remove superseded component versions (irreversible update uninstall)

scripts.name: Flush DNS & Reset Winsock
scripts.description: Flushes DNS cache, re-registers DNS client names, clears NetBIOS name cache, and resets the Winsock catalog.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Reset TCP/IP Stack
scripts.description: Resets IPv4 and IPv6 network stack configurations, releases/renews DHCP leases, and flushes ARP cache.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Optimize TCP Window Scaling & RSS
scripts.description: Configures TCP Receive Window Auto-Tuning, CUBIC/CTCP congestion provider, and Receive-Side Scaling (RSS) for high throughput.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: CongestionProvider
parameters.description: TCP Congestion Control provider (cubic, ctcp, default)

scripts.name: Harden SMB & Disable NetBIOS/LLMNR
scripts.description: Disables SMBv1 protocol, NetBIOS over TCP/IP, and LLMNR multicast resolution, and enforces SMB signing.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Disable Legacy PowerShell 2.0
scripts.description: Removes PowerShell 2.0 downgrade attack surface and enforces Script Block Logging policy.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Verify System File & Image Integrity
scripts.description: Performs full SFC /scannow system file validation and DISM /RestoreHealth image integrity repairs.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: SkipDism
parameters.description: Skip DISM image restore and only run SFC

scripts.name: Enable Ultimate Performance Power Scheme
scripts.description: Duplicates and activates the built-in Windows Ultimate Performance power scheme to minimize hardware latency.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Disable CPU Core Parking (AC)
scripts.description: Unparks 100% of CPU cores on AC power to prevent frequency throttling and thread latency spikes.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Optimize NTFS Memory & I/O
scripts.description: Expands NTFS cache memory pool, disables 8.3 short name creation, and disables last access timestamp writes.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Export Battery & Energy Health Report
scripts.description: Generates HTML battery capacity health and 60-second system energy efficiency audit reports.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: OutputDirectory
parameters.description: Target folder for generated HTML reports

scripts.name: Analyze BSOD Crash Dumps & BugChecks
scripts.description: Inspects Minidump files, MEMORY.DMP headers, and queries System Event Log for BugCheck crash events.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: MaxEvents
parameters.description: Maximum number of recent BugCheck events to display

scripts.name: Dump Process-Mapped Network Connections
scripts.description: Retrieves active TCP/UDP sockets, remote endpoints, and maps owning PID to process names and binary paths.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: StateFilter
parameters.description: TCP connection state filter (All, Established, Listen, TimeWait)

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Maximum number of socket connections to return

scripts.name: Deep Network & Internet Health Audit
scripts.description: Full-stack L1-L7 network health audit: Wi-Fi telemetry, Gateway ping/jitter, MTU fragmentation test, DNS latency benchmark (System/Google/Cloudflare/Yandex), Hosts integrity, Captive Portal, TCP handshake ports (443, 53), and WinINet/WinHTTP proxy audit.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: TargetHost
parameters.description: Target domain for DNS and connectivity testing

scripts.name: Internet Stability, Jitter & Packet Loss Benchmark
scripts.description: Real-time multi-hop latency and stability benchmark: measures Min/Avg/Max latency, jitter (deviation), and packet loss percentage across Local Gateway, National DNS (Yandex), and Global CDN (Cloudflare).
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Number of ICMP packets per target node

scripts.name: Complete Network Stack Reset & Renewal
scripts.description: Comprehensive network restoration: releases and renews IP lease, flushes DNS resolver cache, resets Winsock catalog, resets TCP/IP stack (netsh int ip reset), and re-registers DNS names.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Restore & Clean System Hosts File
scripts.description: Resets %SystemRoot%\System32\drivers\etc\hosts to clean Microsoft default state, removing malicious redirects or corrupted telemetry blocks.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Disable QUIC Protocol (HTTP/3 Workaround)
scripts.description: Disables experimental UDP-based QUIC / HTTP/3 protocol across system registry and Chromium browsers to resolve connection throttling and ISP DPI filtering issues.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Fix Yandex Services & DNS Routing
scripts.description: Flushes specific DNS caches and routes to restore accessibility to Yandex search, cloud, and infrastructure endpoints.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Configure LAN File Sharing & Discovery
scripts.description: Enables network discovery, file and printer sharing, and firewall rules for seamless local network interoperability.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Deep Windows Component & Service Fix
scripts.description: All-in-one system repair: restarts corrupted RPC/WMI/DCOM services, purges temp files, resets network interfaces, and repairs Component-Based Servicing (CBS).
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Windows OS Performance & Privacy Tweaks
scripts.description: Optimizes Windows kernel responsiveness, disables diagnostic telemetry, turns off background gaming DVR overhead, and tunes visual effects for maximum frame rates.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Apply AC High Performance Power Profile
scripts.description: Switches Windows power plan to High/Ultimate Performance with unparked cores and unthrottled GPU clocks for AC mains operation.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Apply Battery Saver Power Profile
scripts.description: Enables energy efficient power scheme with aggressive core idling and reduced display/bus power draws for prolonged battery longevity.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team

scripts.name: Install AC/Battery Auto-Switcher Task
scripts.description: Registers a Windows Scheduled Task to automatically toggle High Performance on AC plug-in and Battery Saver on unplug.
scripts.author: WiScripts Core Team
